summary: ING Groep N.V. furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a home-country disclosure) with a press release updating its €1.0 billion share buyback programme announced 30 April 2026. During 21-25 September 2026, 1,300,000 ING shares were repurchased at an average price of €31.93, for €41,509,042.50. Cumulative repurchases total 28,960,805 shares at an average €28.33, roughly €820.5 million, or about 82.05% of the maximum programme value. No board recommendation, advisor or regulatory clock is stated. The buyback reduces share capital; watch execution pace and completion under the remaining authorization, plus any EPS and CET1 impact.
